page: The Senate register and every compliance figure
what_changed: The scraper that reads the 2000-2011 registers was dropping response dates. The HTML library reads a self-closing line break as an opening tag that wraps whatever follows it, so removing the tag removed the text after it - and in those registers the text after the line break is the response date. A report the register recorded as answered could therefore appear here as never answered. It is fixed by marking the line breaks before the page is parsed rather than after. No published figure moved: the affected rows are in 2000 and 2001, where the register does not record report dates, so they were already excluded from every compliance rate. The defect was found because a rebuild in a clean environment did not reproduce the committed data.
source: scraper/classic_scraper.py; scraper/raw/classic_2000.html, the entry for 'Review of Migration Regulation 4.31B'.
